params.name: W_MAX
params.help: total discharge (soyo was 1800 W)

params.name: DISCHARGE_MAX_PHASE
params.help: discharge per phase

params.name: CHARGE_MAX_PHASE
params.help: PV charge per phase (5000 VA peaks)

params.name: CHARGER_CAP_PHASE
params.help: real charger capacity per phase, priority fill

params.name: SOC_MIN
params.help: no discharge below

params.name: SOC_MIN_RELEASE
params.help: discharge again from

params.name: SOC_FORCE
params.help: grid force charge below

params.name: SOC_FORCE_RELEASE
params.help: force charge until

params.name: FORCE_CHARGE_W
params.help: force charge per phase

params.name: DCL_FORCE_A
params.help: force charge (LOW) while the BMS discharge limit is below this, no discharge (0 = off)

params.name: CELL_FORCE_V
params.help: force charge (LOW) while the lowest cell is below this, no discharge (0 = off)

params.name: CELL_FORCE_RELEASE_V
params.help: LOW ends once the lowest cell is at least this and DCL is back

params.name: SOC_BALANCE_ON
params.help: SoC difference that starts balancing

params.name: SOC_BALANCE_OFF
params.help: balancing ends below

params.name: SOYO_TARGET
params.help: PCC target (+ = export)

params.name: SOFAR_TRICKLE
params.help: night: stacks give this much more than the house needs

params.name: CHARGER_A
params.help: MultiPlus-II charger current per unit (DC), ceiling = this x BMS voltage

params.name: CHARGE_EFF
params.help: AC-in per DC at the charger limit

params.name: BAT1_SOC_MIN
params.help: night: the Sofar Bat1 serves house + heat pump first down to this SoC; 101 = off

params.name: EXPORT_CAP
params.help: summer peak window: while the forecast expects export above this, the stacks charge only the export above it (0 = off)

params.name: HOUSE_EST
params.help: summer peak window: house load assumed when turning the PV forecast into export

params.name: DO4_GRACE_S
params.help: DO4 (FoxESS shedding) only after the PCC stays above 20 kW this long: R290 boost and air conditioning first

params.name: DO4_HARD_W
params.help: DO4 at once above this PCC export

params.name: ACOUT_FEED_MAX_W
params.help: grid offline: DO4 when PV feeds more than this into one MultiPlus AC-out (factor 1.0 rule, 5000 VA; 0 = off)

params.name: ACOUT_FEED_S
params.help: ... for this long

params.name: CHARGER_DC_W
params.help: full_at forecast: DC at the BMS per MultiPlus at its limit

params.name: WP_WINTER_W
params.help: winter half-year (October..March), heat pump running: the stacks discharge nothing while the Sofar Bat1 discharges, else at most this (heat pump off: PCC near 0)

params.name: FORCE_FULL_HOLD_MIN
params.help: force_full_from_pv: the command ends once its stack held 100 % SoC this long (BMS cell balancing)

params.name: FORCE_FULL_MAX_MIN
params.help: force_full_from_pv: the command ends at the latest this long after it came, also below 100 % SoC (0 = off)

params.name: FORCE_FULL_SPREAD_MV
params.help: force_full_from_pv: the command ends once the cell spread of its stack stayed at or below this for 60 s with the highest cell at FORCE_FULL_TOP_V (0 = off)

params.name: FORCE_FULL_TOP_V
params.help: ... the highest cell at least this: the spread counts only at the top of the charge, not at rest

params.name: HOUSE_ACOUT
params.help: house on AC-out1 (0.69-c): winter Z2 near 0 (discharge = AC-out1 load), summer Z1 near 0 (PCC, at least the AC-out1 load); 0 = never (0.68-c matrix, house on the grid), 1 = always, 2 = auto (AC-out total > 99 W, off after 60 s < 30 W)
